background: Original complete unique core-owner camera view; same at-most48 native-resolution median samples before resize

exact: component order and all component fields except confidence
control_gate.mismatch: Preserve all output and diagnostics; block candidate inference and comparable scoring; never substitute the new control for the baseline
control_gate.source_frames: Compare every native row in every complete original target view before any candidate inference or scoring

limitations: Familiar two-source development agent assessments, not expert or independent truth
No established occlusion, camera-transition or visible-unlocalizable support; all unknowns remain
Descriptive pre-threshold responses are not calibrated probabilities or alternate predictions
No threshold search, training, inpainting, label changes, model/default promotion or full-match accuracy claim
No consumed holdout63 inputs, predictions, protocols, private membership metadata or artifacts

metrics.local_support: Closed disk radius0.005*source diagonal around frozen visible label; no coordinate metric for other states
metrics.no_selected_response: Missing/unavailable heatmap remains case; never reinterpret as a negative or drop denominator
metrics.ratio: local_max/global_max when global_max>0, otherwise null with explicit zero support
metrics.uncertainty_support: Separate disk radii max(0,tolerance-uncertainty) and tolerance+uncertainty; never tune uncertainty

name: frozen-development-prethreshold-heatmaps-v1
temporal_ensemble: Every original native source frame in the complete target view; unchanged weighted overlapping windows and scene resets
